The Edo State Police Command has opened an investigation into allegations of extortion against an official of a vigilante group. A statement by the state Police Public Relations Officer, Eno Ikoedem, on Tuesday, said the vigilante official was captured in a viral video extorting money from motorists. She said the entire police team at the checkpoint had been defaulted, while the team leader had been queried for vicarious liability. She said, “The Edo State Police Command wishes to inform the general public of its investigation into a report of extortion by a vigilante personnel in a viral video on social media, showing him at a checkpoint along Agbede with some amount of money found in his possession. “The vigilante operative has been identified by the Area Commander, Auchi Area Command, who has commenced a full-scale investigation into the circumstances surrounding the incident.
